description: Machine-checkable verification probes: one entry per GitHub issue whose resolution (or regression) is observable from flight telemetry. Evaluated by an agent after (or during) a flight against the session event log and the CMTrace app log — see docs/agents/flight-verification.md for the workflow, sources and reporting rules. Probes are evidence-gatherers: a passing probe means 'observed working this flight', never 'auto-close'.

sources.session: JSONL session event log (sessions/session-*.jsonl): one JSON object per line with timestamp, type, payload.
sources.log: CMTrace application log (logs/ProsimCompanion-*.log): component, level (type 1=info 2=warn 3=error), message.
sources.wire: GSX wire trace (logs/ProsimCompanion-wire-*.log): only consulted when a probe names it; often disabled or huge.

kinds.assert-absent: The failure signature must NOT appear. Pass = absent all session; fail = present (quote the evidence).
kinds.assert-present: The fixed/feature behaviour must appear WHEN its trigger occurred. Pass = trigger+behaviour seen; not-exercised = trigger never occurred (report as untested, not passed); fail = trigger seen without the behaviour.
kinds.watch: Health signal with no fixed pass/fail: count and report occurrences with context.
kinds.feature-pending: Issue is an unimplemented feature; probe documents what to assert once it ships. Skip during evaluation, but report accidental sightings.
kinds.requires-human: Not observable from telemetry (web UI, audio quality, installer). Listed so the flight report can remind the pilot what to eyeball.

checks: No 'phase-changed' event into InitialClimb/Climb/Cruise/Descent/Approach whose snapshot has iasKt < 30 AND groundSpeedKt < 30 (with #93 shipped, also onGround=true or powered=false — physically impossible airborne states).

No log line 'GSX "fob restore": ... -> ... (saved value)' before the session has a genuine airborne phase commit (ias > 80 at the transition). The refusal line ('refused — aircraft has not been airborne') is the CORRECT behaviour.
No 'aircraft-state-check' skipped with reason 'already airborne this session' in a session that never actually flew.

assert-present when ProSim connects after the app started: a 'Flight phase classification suspended ... plausible: False' log line during connection warm-up (the plausibility gate doing its job), followed by 'enabled ... plausible: True' once real data arrives.
Any 'airborne-this-session latch withheld' log line is the hardened latch refusing weak evidence — expected on artifacts, report it with its snapshot fields.
probes.notes: Fixed in three layers (2026-08-22): physical-plausibility gate (airborne at <30 kt IAS AND GS = hold Unknown), airborne latch requires convincing evidence (ias>=80 or RA>=200 at commit), Unknown->airborne commits carry a 5 s first-classification debounce. The definitive live test remains: start the app, then start ProSim, and confirm no bogus phase, no FOB restore, and the state check still runs.

checks: If a 'gsx-decision' with reason containing 'waiting for a flight plan' exists, no 'gsx-service' {service: Refueling, event: Active} may occur before a later decision shows the plan was detected (simbriefImported=True or fmsOrigin non-empty in the 'flight plan detection' decision).
probes.notes: The OFP gate only holds the automation path; GSX-side requests bypass it. Fail = fuel/boarding ran planless.

checks: Between 'gsx-service' {Boarding, Requested} and {Boarding, Completed}, at most 2 distinct passenger counts across 'gsx-decision' events with action 'pax target' (reason contains 'armed GSX with N passengers').
probes.notes: 2026-08-16 flight thrashed 89→91→88→85→91→89 from SimBrief pax randomization re-imports during boarding.

checks: When the anchor runs: a 'gate anchor: anchored GSX to 'X' (code)' decision — and REPORT WHICH ladder rung X was (display name, full facility|gate key, bglName, or bare designator): which identity gate.select matches on is the open empirical question this probe answers.
assert-absent: 'gate.select failed for every identity [...]' — the whole ladder refused means a genuinely unknown-to-GSX stand (cross-check the #44 probe).
Arrival selects at decorated stands ('Stand 547 with Safedock©') accept the unambiguous designator match instead of refusing.
probes.notes: Fixed 2026-08-22: the anchor walks an identity ladder (not_found advances, any other code stops) and nearest-matching compares the leading designator so decorations never block. The first flight that logs a ladder winner settles the gate.select contract — record it in docs/integrations/gsx-remote-api.md.

checks: When GSX does not recognize the parking (spawn at an unknown stand): a ground-prep hold with reason 'GSX has not identified the parking — select the stand in the GSX menu, or reposition' (visible on the Flight Status card), AND an 'fo.parking-conflict-advisory' spoken event, once per conflict — including when the only GSX surface is the 'Select Position at ...' menu (the 2026-08-23 gap: only the parking-CHANGE menu was wired, so the hold stayed a log line).
assert-absent: repeated app restarts around a parking-change menu with session gate 'unknown' and no pilot-facing guidance (the 2026-08-17/22 signature).
A 'gsx-question' decision 'position-select menu ... left for the user' when the Select Position menu appears (no more anonymous 'no question handler').
probes.notes: Re-fixed 2026-08-23: the unknown-parking HOLD itself now publishes the parking conflict (advisory + status row), so no particular menu shape is required; the Select Position menu is a named catalogue decision. The app still never clicks GSX's parking menus — it advises.

checks: No duplicated 'gsx-service' (same service+event pair) within 5 seconds.
No duplicated 'ground.calling'/'ground.upcall' for the same call id within one departure/arrival cycle (a second GPU upcall after a genuine reconnect is legitimate — check the mirror context).
No repeated deice completion events for one deice pass.
probes.notes: Mirror-vanish reset and deice id matching can re-arm one-shot events within a cycle.

checks: No detected->cleared->detected cycle for one failure id within 5 minutes (the 2026-08-23 signature: 4 cycles of elec-gen-1-fault in 6 min, tracking the ECP page button).
No 'failure.cleared' while the fault demonstrably persisted (when instructor-injected: the pilot knows; from telemetry: a re-detect of the same id within minutes is the tell).
assert-present when a failure occurs: 'failure.detected' fires within the definition's debounce WITHOUT any ECP page-button interaction.

watch: count 'trigger is firing but corroborate ... reads low — suppressed' log lines (new visibility) — each is a detection a corroborate blocked; also report 'E/WD text channel is live' vs 'returned no content' (which of the two trigger channels this aircraft actually provides).
watch: any abnormal.line outcome 'fault-remains'/'unable' — the new pilot replies in use.
probes.notes: Fixed: I_ECAM_* corroborates removed from all shipped definitions (page buttons only light on manual selection); a latched fault clears ONLY via its authored clearedWhen (signal absence is the no-clearedWhen fallback); corroborate suppression logged once per episode; E/WD text channel re-checked after connect; global 'fault remains'/'no change' and 'unable' replies added to every dialogue line.

checks: No abnormal/ECAM dialogue or master-warning speech for GEN 1/GEN 2 FAULT while no engine has been started this session (pre-start state is normal, not a fault).
No APU FIRE dialogue from a transient shorter than ~2 s (fire signal appears and clears between adjacent events).
probes.notes: Verified live 2026-08-23 (1 h powered, engines off, zero false ECAM) — the engine-running AND-condition carries this alone; the I_ECAM corroborate that over-corrected was removed by #103.

checks: No abnormal-dialogue prompt (repeat of the same demand) spoken more than 60 s after the underlying failure cleared.
Queued dialogues must not starve: any enqueued dialogue eventually speaks or is withdrawn.
probes.notes: 2026-08-15: FO demanded a gen reset 13 minutes after failure.cleared.

checks: Report any abnormal dialogue active > 10 minutes, any interval where the same prompt was spoken 3+ times, and any recognized-but-rejected utterances while a dialogue was awaiting an answer (candidate cancel phrases the pilot tried).
probes.notes: Full fix needs a cancel command (feature); the watch quantifies how often the trap bites and captures what the pilot said trying to escape.

checks: No '401'/'Unauthorized' from the LLM intent client. If the LLM tier is enabled and any free-form utterance fell through to a clarifier, at least one successful LLM intent call should exist.
probes.notes: Dead-key scenario: every utterance silently degraded to 'Say again — which field?' for a whole flight.

checks: Count 'Gateway "metar ..." attempt N/3 failed' lines per airport. Zero failures + a successful METAR consumption = evidence toward closing; persistent 500s = still broken (confirmed 2026-08-17).
probes.notes: Fix will add fallback sources; until then this tracks whether the ProSim gateway endpoint recovered.

checks: Any session JSONL that does not end with a 'session-ended' event = crash/kill signature; report the last events before the cut. Any CMTrace log that stops mid-write. Correlate with USB/audio-device lines just before the end.
probes.notes: The issue asks for global unhandled-exception logging; until it ships, the absent-session-ended heuristic is the only crash telemetry.

checks: No 'phase-changed' Climb→Approach whose snapshot shows verticalSpeedFpm > +300 (positive climb must outvote a stuck gear lever).
probes.notes: Evaluator already guards InitialClimb/TakeoffRoll; this watches the Climb path with the #93 payload fields.

checks: No 'Copied — conditional' (or other ATC-copy reply) spoken in response to an utterance containing 'checklist'.
probes.notes: 'After start/after takeoff checklist' classified as an ATC conditional without any FCU content.

checks: No second VoiceMeeter session/login opened without the previous one closing (pair open/close lines; a mapping change mid-flight is the trigger).
probes.notes: Exercise by changing an audio mapping mid-session (also the #35 watchdog scenario).

checks: Wire log growth: report final size; > 50 MB in one session = the logging-reload storm signature.
Any GSX trigger sent ('trigger sent — waiting for GSX to confirm') with no confirmation within 60 s = dropped request (the #76 GPU case).
Any turnaround LVAR write followed by a SimConnect disconnect within 2 s (write may be lost).
Count GSX retry-noise warning lines.
probes.notes: Four sub-items from the 2026-08-16 log review; each occurrence is evidence for prioritizing the fix.

checks: No 'speech.spoken' containing 'climb performance' while the committed phase is Cruise or later.
probes.notes: Wording should become phase-aware; the spoken text in the session log is the normalizer's final output, so this is directly checkable.

checks: No 'speech.spoken' text matching /\bwinds \d/ — the plural form must be expanded by the AviationSpeech normalizer like the singular already is.
probes.notes: Spoken text is logged post-normalizer, so the raw digit pattern surviving = bug reproduced.

checks: No 'speech.spoken' ATIS text matching /information [a-z]\b/i without the phonetic word (should read 'information Mike'), and no SID/STAR designator spoken with a bare trailing letter.
probes.notes: Partially checkable from text; final pronunciation quality still needs ears (see requires-human list).

checks: Once shipped: briefing/logbook 'speech.spoken' texts contain airport names ('Heathrow') where today they contain bare ICAOs; count bare 4-letter ICAO codes in spoken text as the before/after metric.
probes.notes: DFD airports table already carries airport_name.

checks: 'set standard' → 'voicecommand.executed', then 'voicecommand.verified' with ok=true (the EFIS2 STD gate read 1), then spoken 'Standard, cross checked, passing flight level <digits>' — never the confirmation without the verified event.

With the #109 value fix shipped (2026-08-29): 'set standard' verifies ok=true on the FIRST attempt (retried=false) — the honest negative is no longer an acceptable steady state. 'ok=false' now means the user's %LOCALAPPDATA% commands.json still carries press:1 (see notes) or a new fault.
'set qnh' on descent mirrors this with equals=0 and 'QNH ..., cross checked' — its press value is 1.
probes.notes: Shipped 2026-08-22: {flightLevel} token + per-command verify gate. #109 root cause settled live 2026-08-29 16:42 (A322, cruise, gateway writeInt): S_FCU_EFIS2_BARO_STD value 2 pushes (STD) and value 1 pulls (QNH) — the reverse of the catalog's '1:Pushed, 2:Pulled'. Seed commands.json now presses 2 for STD / 1 for QNH at a 300 ms hold; the 600 ms verify retry stays as belt-and-braces. CAVEAT: a user-edited %LOCALAPPDATA% commands.json keeps its old entries (ADR-0007 keep-user-edits) — the sim PC copy must be updated by hand or re-seeded.

checks: No 'reject'-tagged speech (Didn't catch that / Say again / Repeat please) between a phase commit into TakeoffRoll and the first commit out of InitialClimb, nor during LandingRollout — unmatched utterances there produce 'Idle miss absorbed silently' debug lines instead.
Recognized callouts (engine start, flaps) still answer normally outside those phases.
probes.notes: Suppression shipped 2026-08-22 (the FO chirped 'Say again?' during rotation on that flight); the full FMA-callout recognition remains open on this issue.

checks: 'gear up' after liftoff → a 'voicecommand.gear' {position: up} event, FO speaks 'Gear up.', and NO reject speech (the 2026-08-22 signature was two rejected calls seconds after liftoff).
'gear up' on the ground → refused verbally ('Negative — we are on the ground.') with NO gear event.
'gear down' on approach → 'voicecommand.gear' {position: down} + 'Gear down.'
probes.notes: Gear shipped 2026-08-22 as the first non-FCU PM action (S_MIP_GEAR, airborne-gated). The issue stays open for the remaining PM duties (radio tuning, FCU actions, user-selectable scope).

checks: The loadsheet footer time (HH:mmZ) matches the sim zulu clock captured in the same session (within a few minutes), not the wall clock — decisive whenever the simulated time of day differs from real.
STD-offset prelim decisions ('STD HH:mmZ minus N min reached') fire against the simulated clock.
probes.notes: Fixed 2026-08-22 via the Core ISimClock seam (zulu time-of-day + sim date, 10 s freshness, real-UTC fallback). With no sim running, loadsheets correctly carry real UTC.

checks: From another machine: a telemetry request with ONLY 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' succeeds (no cookie dance), and '?token=...&tailKb=N' onboarding preserves tailKb through the redirect (response size tracks N).
probes.notes: Fixed 2026-08-22 in LanTokenMiddleware. Verified by the evaluating agent itself on its next telemetry pull — this probe is self-exercising.

checks: With the EFB open in a browser, restart the app: the page must reload itself within ~10 s (boot-id watchdog polling /api/app/boot) instead of sitting dead. GET /api/app/boot returns a stable id per process.
probes.notes: A dead tab leaves no server-side events by definition — human-eyeball only, but it takes 15 seconds to test.

checks: When the Voice activation mode is configured: departure services must not auto-start without the voice trigger — 'gsx-decision' shows the gate holding until the pilot's call; with automation mode, auto-start decisions appear as before.
probes.notes: Trigger-dependent: only evaluable in sessions where voice gating was enabled.

checks: Ground-crew upcalls fire on their triggers: 'ground.upcall.gpu' after GPU connect, 'ground.upcall.refuel' after Refueling Completed, 'ground.upcall.catering' after Catering Completed; crew hail dialogues respond on INT.
probes.notes: Upcalls verified live 2026-08-17 (GPU/refuel/catering all spoke). Hail dialogues still unverified — exercise one 'cockpit to ground' hail.

checks: At a non-home-country airport, the ground-crew voice resolution log shows a locale derived from the airport ICAO prefix.
probes.notes: WP4; needs a flight from/to an airport whose prefix maps to a non-default accent.

checks: When INT/RAD is pressed during a running departure sequence: 'gsx-decision' {action: 'force next service', reason: 'requested by INT/RAD'} appears and the next service triggers.
assert-absent: any 'Subscriber handler ... threw System.InvalidCastException' for S_ASP_INTRAD/S_ASP2_INTRAD.
probes.notes: Fixed 7b8db7a after being silently dead (sender cast). Not exercised = report untested.

checks: Voice 'check the aircraft state' → a fresh 'aircraft-state-check' event AND an 'fo.aircraft-state-advisory' speaking the verdict (Pass wording: 'the aircraft is in the expected cold and dark state').
After a Mismatch verdict, making the aircraft cold and dark (phase-changed → ColdAndDark) → automatic re-check with a spoken all-clear.
If asked while the check cannot run: the FO answers 'Standing by' rather than silence.
probes.notes: Shipped fd4c47d, never verified live.

checks: Every 'phase-changed' snapshot payload carries the full field set (onGround, altitudeFt, radioAltitudeFt, verticalSpeedFpm, powered, enginesRunning, engineStarting, pushback, parkBrake, gearDown, takeoffThrust; with #100 shipped, also beacon, apuRunning, rawPushback; with #105 shipped, also fmsCruiseAltFt) — a payload with only iasKt/groundSpeedKt means an old build is running.

With the 2026-08-29 rule table shipped, every 'phase-changed' payload also carries top-level 'rule' (a kebab-case PhaseRule id such as 'takeoff-thrust', or the engine ids 'manual-override' / 'session-ended') and a non-empty 'reason' string.
probes.notes: Doubles as a build-version canary for every other probe that reads these fields.

checks: Each session with a sim flight has exactly one initial 'aircraft-state-check' event (Pass/Mismatch/Skipped with an honest reason); a Mismatch produces the FO advisory when announce is on.
probes.notes: Verified live 2026-08-17.

checks: 'Recognition "listening"' within ~5 s of app start, without a PTT toggle in between.
probes.notes: Verified live 2026-08-17 (all three sessions).

checks: On an app restart mid-turnaround: resync assessment completes, lifecycle latches seed from tracking LVARs/dataref evidence, and the sequencer holds until assessed (no duplicate service calls after restart).

No 'tracking LVARs claim departure progress the ProSim datarefs contradict' decision within ~15 s of app start (the 2026-08-23 false-stale signature: judged before the plan refs pushed, wiped valid LVARs, re-ran Refueling+Catering and re-pumped FOB mid-boarding).
No 'gsx-service' Requested for a service whose prior session recorded Completed in the same departure cycle.
probes.notes: Regressed 2026-08-23, re-fixed: the staleness judgement now waits for the plan refs' first push (bounded by the 90 s window) and unknown facts (null) can neither prove nor condemn. Exercised only by restarting the app mid-cycle.

checks: No SDK-dispatcher watchdog trips and no wedged-worker recoveries when audio mappings change mid-flight.
probes.notes: Deadlock fixed with worker+dispatcher+watchdog; a watchdog LINE FIRING means the underlying wedge returned.

checks: After the last 'phase-changed' event leaving the ground-prep window (current not Preflight/ColdAndDark), every subsequent 'gsx-ground-prep-stage' event carries stage 'Idle' or 'Complete' until the phase returns to the window — any 'Reposition'/'Settling'/'AnchorGate' stage recorded in flight is a fail.
On a mid-flight app restart: no 'gsx-ground-prep-stage' event with an active stage name before landing.
probes.notes: Fix: GsxPrepStage.Idle resting state; resets land on Idle, hold-release publishes 'standing by'. The pill itself ('Idle', neutral tone) is on the requires-human list.

checks: No 'phase-changed' Approach->Climb whose snapshot has verticalSpeedFpm < 800 (the go-around gate).
No 'phase-changed' into Cruise with radioAltitudeFt < 5000 in arrival context (the 14:09:14 'Cruise at 3,000 ft' signature).

No 'callout.fired' positiveClimb, no 'flapsNotRetracted' speech, and no ISA-deviation advisory between the first Approach commit and touchdown, unless a genuine go-around (sustained VS >= 800 fpm) occurred.
assert-present on a deliberate go-around: Approach->Climb still commits within ~5-10 s of sustained TOGA climb.
probes.notes: Two layers (2026-08-22): evaluator keeps Approach below +800 fpm; engine adds a 5 s Approach->Climb settle. Reproduced verbatim at LGAV 14:09:03-14:12:38.

checks: No 'phase-changed' TaxiOut->PushbackAndStart whose snapshot has engineStarting=false (a stray pushback reading must never walk a taxi back).
assert-present during a normal GSX pushback with beacon on: a Preflight->PushbackAndStart commit BEFORE engine start (the beacon+APU window).
probes.notes: Fix: beacon is a necessary gate (Prosim2FO parity), beacon+APU covers the real push window, and only at-gate phases may enter on pushback evidence. The rawPushback watch item was answered on 2026-08-23 — see probe pushback-enum-mapping (#104). ApuRunning has a benign false fallback — if the APU ref never arrives, entry degrades to engine-start-only (report it).

checks: No 'phase-changed' snapshot with pushback=true while airborne or during TaxiOut/TakeoffRoll (the inverted-mapping latch signature: pushback=true for the whole 2026-08-23 flight).

assert-present on a normal departure: a PushbackAndStart->TaxiOut commit exists between the push and TakeoffRoll (the stuck-phase signature was 14 min of taxi in PushbackAndStart, rescued only by TakeoffRoll).
watch: report any rawPushback value other than 3 (idle) or 0 (push in progress) with its context — 1/2 are presumed direction variants, unobserved so far.
probes.notes: Settled enum (2026-08-23 instrumented flight): groundservice.pushback 3 = idle, 0 = push session in progress; mapping inverted accordingly, descriptor fallback = 3. Documented in docs/integrations/prosim.md.

checks: No 'phase-changed' into Cruise whose snapshot has fmsCruiseAltFt >= 1000 AND altitudeFt < fmsCruiseAltFt - 2000 (level-offs below the planned cruise level must hold Climb/Descent).
No 'phase-changed' into Cruise with fmsCruiseAltFt < 1000 AND altitudeFt < 10000 (the no-FMS floor).
No more than 2 Climb<->Cruise transitions per climb and 2 Descent<->Cruise per descent (the 2026-08-23 flight had 6 and 3).
No 'flow.advisory' isaDeviation below 10,000 ft.
assert-present: reaching the FMS cruise level and levelling still commits Cruise within ~30 s.
probes.notes: Fix: evaluator holds the current phase on level flight unless the altitude is cruise-plausible (near aircraft.fms.cruiseAlt, else >= 10,000 ft); established Cruise is exempt (entry-only gate); engine adds a 10 s Cruise->Climb settle. The phase-changed payload carries fmsCruiseAltFt for this check.

checks: No 'phase-changed' snapshot with onGround=false AND takeoffThrust=true (the flag now means thrust set on the ground).
probes.notes: Was an N1-only heuristic: true for the whole climb/cruise on the 2026-08-22 flight, and a latent reverse-thrust->TakeoffRoll trap.

checks: During a pushback with engine start: after 'vehicle state 12 (awaiting good-engine-start confirmation)', a 'confirmed good engine start — tug clear to disconnect' decision appears without any pilot menu interaction.
assert-absent: 'GSX menu '"Interrupt pushback?"' has no question handler' (the 2026-08-23 signature — the pilot had to answer by hand).
A 'good-engine-start confirm failed ... leaving the menu to the pilot' line is the honest give-up path — report it as a menu-shape finding, not a regression.
probes.notes: Auto-confirm gates (Prosim2GSX parity): park brake set, an engine stably running (any — single-engine taxi is real), none mid-start; entry pattern '^confirm good engine' on the Interrupt-pushback menu, retry-capped, fails safe to the pilot.

checks: No more than ONE reject-tagged speech while a single checklist item is open (further misses are absorbed with a debug log).
No reject-tagged speech in Approach below 1,000 ft RA (short-final absorb).
assert-present when exercised: an utterance containing 'as required' or 'checked' completes a non-number checklist item (the verify backstop still cross-checks the switch).
probes.notes: 2026-08-23 lineup: 'As required' rejected 3x on the T CAS item with the spoken nag escalation, plus a 'Repeat please.' between the 1,000 and 500 ft calls on final.

checks: No identical 'callout.fired' id twice within 10 s (2026-08-23: spoilers 2x in 100 ms at touchdown, oneThousandToGo 8x in 1.5 s while the FCU knob was wound).
oneThousandToGo fires at most once per settled FCU target and never inside its ~15 s cooldown.
probes.notes: Fixes: rollout latches re-arm on Approach entry (the LandingRollout commit raced the 100 ms sample tick), oneThousandToGo requires a knob-settled target plus a cooldown.

checks: No 'failure.detected', 'abnormal.*', 'callout.*', cabin, ground-upcall or company-channel speech event before the first 'Flight live true' log line of the session (FlightStateEngine). Any FO speech with the app up and MSFS on the menu / not running is the 2026-08-29 signature.

assert-present after session exit (menu/world map): 'Flight live false' log line, then — if a fault was latched — 'abnormal trigger latches reset'; a running ECAM dialogue ends with 'abnormal.ended' reason 'session-ended' and NO 'ECAM cancelled' / 'has cleared' announcement.
assert-present on the next session start: a still-present fault is re-detected ('failure.detected') after its normal debounce — the latch did not survive the session boundary.
watch: the 'Flight live' true/false edge count per session — more than a handful indicates readiness/plausibility flapping that would mute the FO mid-flight.
probes.notes: Fixed: IFlightPhaseSource.IsLive (session data-meaningful AND datarefs ready AND plausible) is the single FO arming gate; FailureMonitor, FlowMonitor, StabilizedApproachMonitor, CalloutsEngine, CabinCrewService, GroundCrewUpcallService, CompanyChannelService and MissedApproachRebrief hold on it; an empty abnormal 'phases' list no longer arms in Unknown. PTT/recognition and TTS prewarm are deliberately NOT gated (TTS/STT server configuration must remain testable with no sim).

checks: Trigger = the pilot spoke (any 'FO PTT down' line, or continuous mode with the app up and the LAN ASR reachable). Behaviour = at least one 'ASR heard' line (UtteranceRouter, Debug) in the session. A session with recognition 'listening' for minutes and ZERO 'ASR heard' lines is the 2026-08-29 signature (server answering 404 to /transcribe while /health was green).

assert-absent: Warning 'LAN ASR server … answered … for flavour … check speech.asrApi matches the server' (LanAsrRecognizer). Present = speech.asrApi does not match the server at speech.asrBaseUrl (or the server is mis-routed) — quote the status code and flavour.
assert-present at start: 'LAN ASR ready (WhisperCpp at …)' or '(FasterWhisper at …)' naming the configured flavour; 'Falling back to offline recognition' means the box never answered within 120 s.
watch: 'ASR heard' lines with conf 0.00 / acoustic null under WhisperCpp — the server answered plain json (no segments); response_format=verbose_json was not honoured.
probes.notes: Fixed: speech.asrApi (fasterWhisper | whisperCpp) selects path (/transcribe vs /v1/audio/transcriptions), bias field (hotwords vs prompt) and response parsing (AsrServerApi, unit-tested); whisper.cpp confidence = exp(duration-weighted avg_logprob), no_speech_prob = max over segments — the wrapper's own formula. Non-2xx or unparseable transcribe replies now log one Warning per episode instead of being swallowed as empty-text rejects.

checks: No 'failure.detected' / 'abnormal.started' event while the most recent 'phase-changed' snapshot says powered:false (phase ColdAndDark). The 2026-08-29 signature: 'failure.detected fctl-altn-law' ~5 s after 'Flight live "true"' with the aircraft cold and dark, then 'Mic borrowed by "abnormal:fctl-altn-law"'.

assert-present when a trigger is genuinely firing cold and dark (e.g. fctl-altn-law on controlLaw.numerical): one Information line 'Abnormal <id> trigger is firing but the aircraft is unpowered (ColdAndDark) — held, no ECAM to read' (FailureMonitor), and no dialogue.

assert-absent after power-up (phase Preflight, powered:true): 'failure.detected fctl-altn-law' with I_MIP_MASTER_CAUTION_FO low — the corroborate must suppress it ('trigger is firing but corroborate … reads low — suppressed'). A genuine alternate law (master caution lit) must still detect.
watch: which abnormal ids log the unpowered hold in a cold-and-dark session — each one is a definition whose raw condition reads faulty on an unpowered aircraft.
probes.notes: Fixed: FailureMonitor.PhaseArmed — an empty phases list no longer arms in ColdAndDark (nor Unknown, #114); an explicit 'ColdAndDark' entry still arms. fctl-altn-law gained corroborate I_MIP_MASTER_CAUTION_FO. Live-verify the powered-but-no-hydraulics preflight case: controlLaw.numerical values cold / powered / normal were never instrumented.

checks: Trigger = departure sequence runs with gsx.skipRefuelOnTankering on and the FOB at or above the OFP block fuel minus 25 kg (compare aircraft.fuel.total in the first 'refuel sync' or loadsheet lines against OfpData.FuelPlanRampKg / the OFP import line). Behaviour = 'gsx-decision' action 'skip Refueling' whose reason contains 'tankering) — GSX refuel not called', a decision 'refuel skipped for tankering' … 'preliminary loadsheet trigger raised', and NO 'trigger Refueling' from the sequencer nor 'GSX service "Refueling": Requested' that session. The 2026-08-29 signature (session 223842): trigger at 08:42:21, sync 'skipped (tankering)' only at 08:44:07 after Active, six minutes of truck animation, 'refueling complete, 9.6 tonnes' upcall.
assert-present (no regression) when FOB is below the plan: the normal 'trigger Refueling' — 'next in departure order' and the refuel-sync activation line.
assert-present: with the skip, a preliminary loadsheet still appears (loadsheet events / 'preliminary' log lines) when flightData.autoPrelimOnRefuel is on.
assert-absent: 'ground.upcall.refuel' speech in a tankering-skipped cycle — the crew must not announce a refuel that never happened.
probes.notes: Fixed: RefuelCore.TankeringSkipReason (OFP block fuel first, else efb.plannedfuel; aircraft.refuel.fuelTarget deliberately ignored pre-session) feeds DepartureSequencer.Next(preSkip) from GsxAutomationService; the skipped step counts as settled so AfterAllCompleted boarding proceeds; RaiseRefuelServiceActive is raised once per cycle in place of the missing refuel-active edge. The in-service skip in RefuelCore remains for externally-called refuels.

checks: Trigger = the pilot presses the Stream Deck Voice Pause key (or the web 'Pause listening' button): a 'speech.toggleListening' / 'speech.pauseListening' command line, or the RecognitionController Info line 'Voice recognition paused by the pilot'. Behaviour = within the same second a 'Recognition stopped (<engine>)' transition (continuous mode, window open) and NO 'Recognition listening' until the matching 'Voice recognition resumed by the pilot' line.
assert-present: after 'resumed by the pilot' in continuous mode with a window open, 'Recognition listening (<engine>)' follows without any PTT edge or window churn in between.
assert-absent: any FO speech tagged to the pause/resume edges — the toggle is deliberately silent (owner decision 2026-08-29).
assert-absent: 'Speech recognition failed to start' retry episodes starting while paused — pause flips desire off, so the #61 retry loop must not run.
probes.notes: Feature, not a fix (no issue number): IVoiceListeningControl on RecognitionController, commands speech.pause/resume/toggleListening, /api/status voice:{listening,paused}, Stream Deck 'Voice Pause' action, web pill + button on the First Officer tab. Runtime latch only — cleared by an app restart.

checks: While the flight is live, 'flight-sample' events appear at roughly the configured interval (default 1 s) whenever the sampled state changes, and at least every keep-alive (default 10 s) while it does not; none appear while the session is not live (before MSFS is in a flight, or on the menu).

Each payload carries the short-key field set (ph, og, ias, gs, alt, ra, agl, vs, pwr, eng, engRaw, st, pb, pbRaw, brk, gear, apu, bcn, thr, n1, n1avg, flap, fcu, fms, v1, vr, v2) and 'ph' equals the phase most recently committed by 'phase-changed'.

Replay check: run FlightReplay over the session file (tests: FlightReplayTests / drop the file into tests/ProsimCompanion.Core.Tests/Flight/Recordings) — the replayed timeline must match the recorded 'phase-changed' edges after the first sample ('matches the recording'). A divergence means the live build and the repo's rule table disagree: report the first differing edge with its rule id and reason.
probes.notes: Feature, not a fix (2026-08-29 robustness review): per-second FlightSampleRecorder + FlightReplay harness. Session files grow to a few MB per flight; the logbook/debrief readers skip the event type.

checks: After a 'phase-changed' into Shutdown, Shutdown -> Preflight (rule 'turnaround-arrival-complete') happens ONLY after 'gsx-service' {Deboarding, Completed} (log: 'Arrival complete (deboarded) — the turnaround to Preflight is now armed') plus the hold (default 30 s) parked with the beacon off — never before deboarding completes (2026-08-29 ESSA: the old time-only 'turnaround-parked' fired at +30 s mid-deboarding, prep repositioned the aircraft and services ran).

On that turnaround Preflight: the prep chain goes Idle -> GroundEquipment ('turnaround — on stand already, skipping reposition'), never Reposition; and with gsx.groundPrepActivation = voice there is NO 'departure sequence — auto-started (Preparation phase)' decision — the sequence waits for 'commence ground services'.

If the beacon goes on and an engine starts (or the brake is released with the APU running) while still in Shutdown, 'phase-changed' Shutdown -> PushbackAndStart with rule 'turnaround-start' — never Shutdown -> TaxiIn.
assert-absent: any 'phase-changed' Shutdown -> TaxiIn.
probes.notes: Pre-2026-08-29 the only exit from Shutdown was ColdAndDark (powered=false); an engine start after shutdown evaluated to TaxiIn and leg 2 of a multi-leg day never got GSX prep. Consumers already expected Shutdown/TaxiIn -> Preflight (CompanyChannelService, CompanyDayService, ArrivalCore).

checks: No pair of 'phase-changed' events X -> InitialClimb and InitialClimb -> X (or Approach -> LandingRollout -> Approach) closer than 1 s apart — a one-sample flicker of the on-ground flag must be absorbed by the agreement filter (default 2 samples).
Log: any 'Ground contact committed ... after N agreeing sample(s)' Debug line precedes the corresponding runway transition when Debug logging is on.
probes.notes: Prosim2GSX GroundTicks parity, 2026-08-29. Configurable on the Flight Phase settings page (Ground contact agreement).

checks: A go-around (sustained VS > 800 fpm from Approach or LandingRollout) records 'phase-changed' Approach|LandingRollout -> InitialClimb with rule 'go-around', followed by 'goaround.detected' (missed-approach re-brief) — not Approach -> Climb.
assert-absent: 'phase-changed' Approach -> Climb.
probes.notes: Before 2026-08-29 the evaluator sent go-arounds to Climb, which MissedApproachRebrief, CalloutsEngine and StabilizedApproachMonitor never see (they key on the InitialClimb edge).

checks: When MSFS leaves the flight (menu / world map) after a phase was committed, a 'phase-changed' <phase> -> Unknown with rule 'session-ended' is recorded and the log carries 'MSFS flight session ended'; the next session's first commit starts from Unknown.
assert-absent: a new session's first 'phase-changed' whose previous phase is anything but Unknown.
probes.notes: 2026-08-29: previously only the airborne latch reset on NotInSession and the phase leaked into the next flight.

checks: Count 'phase-changed' events with rule 'manual-override' (reason 'manual override (<source>)') and the matching Warning log lines 'Manual phase override by ...'; report each with what the rule table would have said next (the next automatic commit after 'Manual phase override released').
assert-absent: an 'airborne-this-session' latch opening (FOB restore / cabin landing report) on a manual-override commit alone.
probes.notes: Web Flight Status 'Phase engine' row: Force / freeze / Resume auto (2026-08-29). Frequent use on a flight is a signal the rule table needs a recording-backed fix.

checks: No 'gsx-decision' (component 'loadsheet') with reason 'prelim aborted: ...implausible...' or 'no OFP imported — cannot generate a preliminary loadsheet' that was produced by an AUTOMATIC trigger: after 'refuel skipped for tankering' / a Refueling Active edge / 'STD ... reached', the loadsheet decisions must read 'automatic prelim (<trigger>) waiting for ...' (zero or more) then 'PRELIM EDNO n sent' — never a Failed slot that a manual Resend then fixes.

assert-present when a blocker existed: 'automatic prelim (<trigger>) waiting for an OFP import' or '... waiting for the CG datarefs ...' followed within 20 min by 'automatic prelim (<trigger>) — inputs ready, generating' and 'PRELIM EDNO n sent'.
The Loadsheet page shows WAITING (not ERROR) with the reason while the trigger is armed (web UI).
probes.notes: 2026-08-29 (tankering leg): the tankering pre-skip raised the prelim edge before the prelim's inputs existed (OFP / CG datarefs after a restart) and the page showed ERROR until Resend. PrelimTriggerPolicy now arms a 10 s re-check for up to 20 min; a manual Resend still generates immediately.

checks: While the Kokoro host is up (any successful kokoro synthesis in the session), no 'TTS provider "kokoro" failed' Warning — in particular none whose reason reads 'timed out after ... (body — N chars still streaming)' for a long utterance (briefing, checklist line, ATC readback).

assert-present when the host is asleep/unreachable: a single-line 'TTS provider "kokoro" failed: Kokoro TTS timed out after 1500 ms (connect — host asleep or unreachable); cooling down 60s' with NO stack trace, then fall-through to the next provider.
watch: count 'cooling down 60s' lines for kokoro — the 2026-08-29 baseline was 8 in one leg.
probes.notes: 2026-08-29: the single 1.5 s budget covered the whole streamed WAV; split into connect (kokoroTimeoutMs) + body (kokoroBodyTimeoutMs + 100 ms/char). Cooldown now starts at the failure instant.

checks: Every 'gsx-decision' '... — the call was dropped' (after the automatic retry) is followed within 1 s by a 'gsx-call-dropped' event {service, openMenu, consecutive} AND an 'fo.dropped-call-advisory' event with the spoken text ('Captain, ground did not pick up the <service> call ...'); the Flight Status GSX card shows 'Dropped Call: <service> at HH:mm:ss' until a later call confirms (web UI).
assert-absent: a dropped call with no advisory (the 2026-08-29 15:31:33 Deboarding signature).
